summary: This is a routine 8-K filing by Visa Inc. reporting its fiscal Q2 2026 earnings results and declaring a quarterly cash dividend of $0.670 per share. The filing discloses net revenue of $11.2B (up 17%), GAAP net income of $6.0B ($3.14/share), and a new $20.0B share repurchase program authorization. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital returns beyond ordinary dividends, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is present. This is a standard financial update with no unusual corporate action.
